_comment: Per-class augmentation tuning. Copy this file to work/targets.json and edit. 'target' = how many synthetic contracts to emit for that class. 'cap' = how many injection jobs to queue (must be >= target; absorbs injection + dedup attrition, and is the ceiling for run-time re-tuning). bug_type is fixed and not tunable here. Any class you omit keeps the built-in default.
